summary: Iter 191 mobile-only validation for aged-care app. Backend POST /api/documents multipart upload contract verified via pytest (4/4 pass). Mobile UI verified in Expo web preview: (1) Documents modal opens with all expected testIDs (documents-add-button, upload-source-file/library/camera, upload-category-*, upload-title, upload-submit-button, upload-close); (2) Guided Journeys shows exactly 4 steps starting with Classification Self-Check and 'of 4 done', 'Your situation' persona step is REMOVED; (3) All 8 tool screens render their title only ONCE (AppHeader only, no duplicate in-body heading); (4) AppDrawer 'Log Out' casing confirmed (Title Case) with testID drawer-logout. Everything requested is verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: documents.tsx line 349 correctly reads '10 MB' matching backend MAX_FILE_BYTES=10MB (was 25MB in a prior copy fix — verified aligned).
documents.tsx uses `apiFetch('/documents', { isForm: true })` and appends multipart FormData with file/category/title — matches backend contract in /app/backend/documents_routes.py:167.
journeys.tsx STEP_META has 4 entries starting with 'Classification Self-Check' (csc) — persona ('Your situation') step is not rendered; progress bar correctly uses STEP_META.length (4).

All 8 tool screens ({[slug]}.tsx and src/components/tools/*.tsx) render title exactly once via AppHeader. Large-heading scan (>=20px) found exactly 1 matching heading per tool where the title was visible.
AppDrawer.tsx:91 renders 'Log Out' (Title Case) — verified in preview.
seed_data_creation: None — uploaded a small PDF blob via API test and deleted it in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend POST /api/documents multipart auth-onboarded upload is covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter191_documents_upload.py (reusable regression). Native file picker in the mobile modal cannot be driven from Playwright/web preview, so end-to-end file selection was not exercised in UI — backend contract test validates the same upload path the mobile client uses. Login via web preview: fill email/password inputs then click text 'Sign In' with force=True (Pressable, not a real <button>). After login the app lands on '/' (tabs home). To open the drawer, click testID 'tab-more' — the tab's listener calls openDrawer() rather than navigating.
